      • getCmax

        public int getCmax(boolean isHonorStudent)
        return the maximum number of credits a student may take in a semester. This corresponds to the value of the property "CmaxHonor" in the file if the student is an honors' student, and to the value of the property "Cmax" otherwise.
        Parameters:
        isHonorStudent - boolean this value is read from the GUI
        Returns:
        int

      • getSummerCmax

        public int getSummerCmax(boolean isHonorStudent)
        same as getCmax(boolean) but for the entire summer season which includes Summer-1 ("S1"), Summer-2("S2") and Summer-Term ("ST"). The existence of these numbers makes the total number of credits students are allowed to take during the summer months much less than what it is now.
        Parameters:
        isHonorStudent - boolean
        Returns:
        int

      • getMaxNumCoursesPerTerm4Freshmen

        public int getMaxNumCoursesPerTerm4Freshmen()

        Returns:
        int

        Returns:

      • getPrograms2Maximize

        public java.util.Set<ProgramCodeStruct> getPrograms2Maximize()
        return the set of program codes (eg "ITC", "MA" etc) whose number of courses we seek to maximize as last resort criterion. The property value must separate the program codes by semi-columns. Some program cores may even designate exception groups eg "MA\LE-core-stat". Optional.
        Returns:
        Set<String>

      • getCourses2Plan4LastTerms

        public java.util.Set<java.lang.String> getCourses2Plan4LastTerms()
        return the set of course codes (eg "PS4935") for which there is a "soft-constraint" that the plan should have them in the end. The easiest way to do this is by adding the time-slotted corresponding binary vars in the objective function with coefficients that get smaller as the term gets larger. Soft-order constraints can then help with the order between those courses (if pre-requisites are not enough).
        Returns:
        Set<String> // cannot be null

      • getProgramCode

        public java.lang.String getProgramCode()
        return the program code ("ITC" for the B.Sc. in IT). This is the prefix of the course codes that the list of desired courses is going to show, that will be allowed to edit the time-slots in a schedule etc.
        Returns:
        String
